title: Running Max
statement: Implement `solve(items)`. `items` is a non-empty list of integers. Return a list of the same length where position `i` is the maximum of `items[0]` through `items[i]` inclusive.
hints: Start the best value at the first element.
Walk left to right, raising best when the current item is larger.
Append best on every step, including the first.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Prefix maxima are one variable and one pass.

editorial: Prefix maxima are one variable and one pass. Re-scanning the prefix at every index is quadratic and produces the same list. The first element is the maximum of a prefix of length 1, so it is always copied into the output.
